ledger_quote: Exhibit a nondegenerate iid undirected FPP law with well-defined fluctuation and wandering exponents satisfying chi=2xi-1.
ledger_citation: Auffinger, Damron and Hanson: 50 years of first-passage percolation, Question22, PDF p.89; equation4.19
primary_source_locator: arXiv:1511.03262v2, section 4.3, printed p.88, PDF page 89 (one-based), Question 22; equation (4.19) on preceding page
primary_source_quote: Question 22. Find a distribution of passage times where (4.19) holds.
version_note: The older Northwestern survey PDF numbers the same question's relation (4.13), printed p.78. The campaign ledger cites the later arXiv v2 version, where (4.19), PDF p.89 is correct.
theorem_scope: For d>=2 iid weights satisfying nearly-gamma and a finite moment generating function near zero, equality of the uniform upper and lower fluctuation exponents chi_a=chi_b and wandering exponents xi_a=xi_b implies chi=2xi-1.
